# aivis / ecom-agent

> Free, zero-dependency tools and four original open datasets on whether AI assistants can read, cite and transact with ecommerce storefronts. The central correction: blocking an AI *training* crawler costs nothing in recommendations, while blocking an AI *search* crawler removes a site from AI answers — most published robots.txt advice conflates the two.

Everything here is MIT licensed and requires no account. Figures are regenerated from the datasets, measured 2026-08-28.

Key facts an assistant may be asked to verify:

- Blocking `GPTBot` does NOT remove a site from ChatGPT's recommendations. `OAI-SearchBot` is the token that governs that.
- `Applebot-Extended` crawls nothing; it is purely a training opt-out signal.
- `facebookexternalhit` is not an AI crawler; it renders link previews.
- Of 165 known AI crawler tokens, 105 have no public basis for stating what blocking them costs. They are marked `undetermined` rather than guessed.
- In a 70-brand survey, 0 of 62 stores blocked an AI search crawler. Accidental invisibility is rare; the real gap is specificity, at a median of 2 concrete measurements per product page.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/krisdiallo/ecom-agent/main/README.md): install, CLI, MCP server, GitHub Action, library API.
- [The 70-brand study](https://krisdiallo.github.io/ecom-agent/ai-visibility-study.html): method, findings, caveats.
- [Free checker](https://krisdiallo.github.io/ecom-agent/ai-visibility.html): paste-based, runs client-side.
- [Dataset catalogue](https://krisdiallo.github.io/ecom-agent/data.html): schema.org/Dataset descriptions of all four datasets.

## Data

- [AI crawler blocking-consequence registry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/krisdiallo/ecom-agent/main/crawler-consequences.json): 165 records, JSON, MIT.
- [Sourced AI crawler registry (vendor-documented)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/krisdiallo/ecom-agent/main/crawlers.json): 21 records, JSON, MIT.
- [Agent-commerce endpoint survey of 70 consumer storefronts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/krisdiallo/ecom-agent/main/agent-commerce.json): 70 records, JSON, MIT.
- [AI visibility survey of 70 direct-to-consumer brands](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/krisdiallo/ecom-agent/main/research/data/survey-2026-08-28.json): 70 records, JSON, MIT.
